notes.title: Gallery display order changes
notes.notes: We've changed gallery display order. From now on content in Gallery will be displayed: 1. rank related  2. events 3. chat 4. clicker events,  and in rank/numerical order instead of unlock order.

notes.title: 2 changes :]
notes.notes:
Hello,

We intorduce 2 changes: 
1st - compression for big maps - to help players, who have a lot of bubbles (please, don't hoard) and couldn't play events anymore, because their save file was over limits. Now they will be able to play, however their home level still can work super slow. Please, declutter your Home. The space isn't unlimited.

2nd - unlocked game zones  (upgrades) from minigames will be assigned to your gallery as an adultcontent.

Thx,
Dev Team
